I thought that deadly disease was extinct.|[[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|audio=BlueShadowVirus-BSV.flac|<ref name="BSV">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Blue Shadow Virus''' was a devastating virus responsible of the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] that devastated [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] generations before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The virus was later used in a biological weapons plot by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|The Blue Shadow Virus in its natural form thrives ''only'' in water.|Dr. Nuvo Vindi|audio=ThrivesOnlyInWater-BSV.flac|<ref name="BSV" />}}
[[File:Waterborne_Blue_Shadow_Virus.png|thumb|left|200px|The waterborne virus in a [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] river.]]
The Blue Shadow Virus was notorious for being able to affect every known species in the galaxy, was said to be completely fatal, and was supposedly incurable. It was a waterborne virus.

==History==
{{Quote|Your eyes do not deceive you. I have perfected an ''airborne'' strain of the Blue Shadow Virus.|Dr. Nuvo Vindi|audio=AirbornStrain-BSV.flac|<ref name="BSV" />}}
{{Main|Candorian plague/Legends}}
The virus ran rampant across the galaxy several generations before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. To the relief of the general public, it was eventually eradicated when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] enacted strict quarantines that contained the Blue Shadow Virus on affected worlds, preventing it from spreading until it eventually died out.

Despite this, at least one mutated form of the virus still existed which became known as the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]]; In [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]],<ref name="GNN5">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> this plague eradicated the population of [[Candoria]] and its [[Candorian colonies|colonies]].<ref name="TEA-">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

During the Clone Wars, a mentally unstable scientist, [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]], recreated the Blue Shadow Virus with the help of the mad [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]].<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> When [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] were captured, he claimed the virus was not eradicated, but murdered. He also claimed he had recreated life: the life of the virus. Though the virus originally spread through water and killed [[Shaak/Legends|certain species]] instantly, Vindi was able to create an airborne version. The airborne strain's incubation period was longer than the waterborne varieties. Respiratory symptoms preceded death.

[[File:Blue_Shadow_Virus_cloud.png|thumb|left|200px|The Blue Shadow Virus in gaseous form]]
Jar Jar and Padmé tried to convince Vindi of the danger of releasing the virus, but he refused to listen and attempted to release the virus anyway. However, a detachment of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was dispatched, and the [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] was successfully [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|secured]]. However, Vindi's servant droid [[LEP-86C8/Legends|LEP-86C8]] was soon able to detonate one remaining bomb, infecting Padmé, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Before the virus could kill everyone trapped in the laboratory, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were able to find the cure: the [[Reeksa/Legends|Reeksa root]]. After obtaining enough of the root from [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], all the infected were cured.

The airborne version of the virus was used as a bioweapon by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], especially during the [[Dentaal Uprising]].<ref name="GNN5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blue Shadow Virus was created in [[2009]] and first appeared in the [[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|17th episode]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]].<ref name="BSV" /> The same year, the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]]ed the Blue Shadow Virus as the virus that caused the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]],<ref name="TEA-" /> a disease created in the [[1995]] magazine [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 5]],<ref name="GNN5" /> and widely extended in the next two decades.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref><ref name="TKEG">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref><ref name="THoMA">{{SW|url=news/the-history-of-mandalorian-armor|text=The History of Mandalorian Armor|int=The History of Mandalorian Armor|nolive=1}}</ref> This retcon was conserved after the [[2014]] [[canon]] reboot as the [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] sourcebook ''[[Unlimited Power]]'' clearly associated the Blue Shadow Virus and the [[Candorian Scourge]].<ref name="UP">''[[Unlimited Power]]''</ref>
